We’re introducing a new statewide scheduling and check-in system for DMV services!
Why? To save time (yours!) and create a more consistent experience across county service locations, including right here in MITCHELL COUNTY TREASURER’S OFFICE
What does it mean for you? Beginning January 20, 2026, customers will be able to:
Schedule appointments for any DMV service at any service center or county treasurer office in nearly 80 participating counties.
See which locations have availability for the service you need, when you need it.
Receive appointment reminders and have the ability to reschedule or cancel online.
Check in through a kiosk in our lobby.
To schedule an appointment, go to https://iowadot.gov/drivers-licenses…/schedule-appointment
CALL TO SCHEDULE AN APPOINTMENT FOR DRIVERS LICENSE: (641) 832-3940

Property Tax
Business hours: 8:00am to 4:30pm – Monday thru Friday
First half property tax due Sept 30, Second half property tax due March 31.
All special assessment payments due Sept 30 of each year.
Iowa Property Tax Credit Claim filed each year with the County Treasurer by June 1. Must be over 65 or totally disabled to apply.
Tax Sale held the third Monday of June each year at 10:00am. Must be registered to bid by the Friday before. Registration fee $10.
>>>> PAY PROPERTY TAXES ONLINE
Accepted On-Line Payment Methods-eCheck, Discover, MasterCard and Visa are accepted for online transactions.
NOW TAKING APPLICATIONS FOR ELDERLY/ DISABLED PROPERTY TAX CREDIT
Due to a recent legislative change by the Iowa Legislature, eligibility for the Elderly Property Tax Credit was expanded on the basis of household income for those over 70 years old. Under the new rules, those who were previously unable to claim the credit due to having too high of an income may now qualify for the credit on next year’s tax bill and in subsequent years.
Those aged 70 and older must continue to file for the credit each year to receive the maximum benefit of the new tax credit calculation.
The Mitchell County Treasurer’s Office is now accepting applications for the Elderly and Disabled Tax Credit through September 30.
Eligible Mitchell County Citizens should submit their completed applications to the Mitchell County Treasurer’s Office at 212 S. 5 th Street, Osage, IA 50461 Applications submitted this year will be applied to next year’s tax bill.
For more information on eligibility criteria and to download the 2022 Property Credit Claim application use the following link: Iowa Property Tax Credit Claim, 54001
